tagline: The shore way from Branford to the Guilford green.
intro: Route 146 slips behind the Branford green and heads south to the Sound at Indian Neck, then east along the shore to Pine Orchard. There it turns inland by Stony Creek Road and Leetes Island Road into Guilford, passing under the Amtrak tracks several times on the way, and comes round the south side of the Guilford green to US 1.

In the middle of the 19th century Branford was a resort with some twenty hotels, the Montowese House at Indian Neck and the Sheldon House at Pine Orchard among them. Guilford is older. Its 24 Puritan families signed their covenant at sea in 1639.

moments.title: Indian Neck
moments.text: Trolleys once ran down to Sybil and Limewood avenues, where the tourist trade kept a bait shop, inns and a Dairy Joy, and the shops closed as the houses turned year-round.

moments.title: Guilford Green
moments.text: The road runs along the south side of the 7.7-acre green, ringed with shops, churches and the town hall, and ends at US 1 a little east of it.
